moments.title: UK Singles Chart #1 & New Entries
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for this week sees Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the top spot, while Madonna & Kylie Minogue make a splash with a new entry.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds strong at Number 1 this week. Can anything knock them off? #UKChart

angles.name: Pop Royalty
angles.copy: Pop royalty unite! Madonna and Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' is a brand new entry at #8 on the Official Singles Chart. We love to see it! #NewMusic

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Aftermath
moments.blurb: The Hundred finals took place yesterday, August 16th, at Lord's, with the Trent Rockets women and Manchester Super Giants men winning their respective titles.

angles.name: Cricket Champions
angles.copy: What a finals day! Huge congratulations to Trent Rockets (women) and Manchester Super Giants (men) for being crowned The Hundred champions yesterday at Lord's. What was your highlight? #TheHundred

angles.name: Sporting Spectacle
angles.copy: The Hundred delivered another thrilling finals day! If you watched, what was the most nail-biting moment for you? #Cricket

moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially kicks off this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League returns this Friday, August 21st! Who are you backing for the title this season? #PremierLeague

angles.name: Opening Match
angles.copy: Defending champions Arsenal take on newly promoted Coventry City in the Premier League opener this Friday. Big start to the season! #FootballIsBack

moments.title: EFL Season Underway
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship, League One, and League Two seasons are now underway, with matches being played throughout the week.

angles.name: EFL Action
angles.copy: The EFL season is in full swing! Great to see the Championship, League One, and League Two back with plenty of action this week. Who's your team to watch? #EFL

angles.name: Welsh Football Focus
angles.copy: Wrexham are back in the Championship and the EFL season is underway! Who are you cheering on from Wales this season? #WelshFootball #EFL

moments.title: Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix
moments.blurb: The Formula 1 Heineken Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort, the 'very last Dutch Grand Prix', takes place this weekend from August 21st to 23rd.

angles.name: Final Zandvoort Race
angles.copy: It's the FINAL Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort this weekend (Aug 21-23)! Expect an incredible atmosphere and a race for the ages. Who's your pick for the win? #F1 #DutchGP

angles.name: Race Weekend
angles.copy: Gear up for a high-octane weekend as F1 heads to Zandvoort for the Dutch Grand Prix. Practice, Sprint, Qualifying and Race – all happening this weekend! #Formula1

moments.title: We Out Here Festival
moments.blurb: We Out Here Festival, curated by Gilles Peterson, runs from August 20th-23rd in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, celebrating world-class music, wellness, and culture.

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival kicks off this Thursday! Four days of incredible music, wellness, and good vibes in Dorset. Who's heading down? #WeOutHere

angles.name: Gilles Peterson's Creation
angles.copy: Curated by the legendary Gilles Peterson, We Out Here is a must for lovers of soul, hip hop, house, afro, electronica, and jazz. Running Aug 20-23! #Festival

moments.title: Green Man Festival
moments.blurb: Wales' largest independent music and arts festival, Green Man, takes place from August 20th-23rd in the Brecon Beacons.

angles.name: Welsh Festival Fun
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is almost here! Wales' biggest independent music & arts festival lights up the Brecon Beacons this Thursday-Sunday. Are you ready? #GreenManFestival

angles.name: Brecon Beats
angles.copy: From music to art, literature to comedy, Green Man Festival in the Brecon Beacons has it all. Kicking off August 20th! #Wales #Festival

moments.title: Beautiful Days Festival
moments.blurb: The family-friendly Beautiful Days Festival runs from August 21st-23rd in Ottery Saint Mary, Devon.

angles.name: Devon Festival
angles.copy: Beautiful Days Festival starts this Friday in Ottery Saint Mary! Three days of music and fun for all the family. Who's heading to Escot Park? #BeautifulDays #Devon

angles.name: Local Music
angles.copy: The countdown to Beautiful Days is on! Get ready for a fantastic weekend of music and arts right here in Devon. Aug 21-23! #Exeter #Festival

moments.title: Major UK Festivals Approaching
moments.blurb: Big UK festivals like Reading & Leeds (Aug 28-30), Creamfields (Aug 27-29), and All Points East (Aug 21-30) are all happening next week.

angles.name: Festival Frenzy
angles.copy: Who's ready for a huge week of festivals?! Reading & Leeds, Creamfields, and All Points East are all happening from next week. Get your wellies ready! #UKFestivals

angles.name: August Bank Holiday Prep
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday weekend is shaping up to be massive with Reading & Leeds and Creamfields bringing the noise. What's your festival pick? #SummerFestivals

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle's Birthday
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, lead singer of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist, turns 68 today. (Born August 17, 1958).

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the incredible Belinda Carlisle! From The Go-Go's to her brilliant solo career, a true 80s icon. What's your favourite hit? #BelindaCarlisle #80sMusic

moments.title: Robert Plant's Birthday
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant celebrates his 78th birthday on August 20th. (Born August 20, 1948).

angles.name: Rock God
angles.copy: This Thursday, August 20th, we're celebrating the 78th birthday of rock god Robert Plant! The voice of Led Zeppelin – what's your ultimate Zep track? #RobertPlant #LedZeppelin

moments.title: Shirley Manson's Birthday
moments.blurb: Garbage frontwoman Shirley Manson turns 60 on August 26th. (Born August 26, 1966).

angles.name: 90s Alt Queen
angles.copy: Next Wednesday, August 26th, marks Shirley Manson's 60th birthday! The iconic voice and force behind Garbage. What's your favourite Garbage anthem? #ShirleyManson #Garbage

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Prep
angles.copy: That glorious August Bank Holiday Monday is just two weeks away (Aug 31st)! What are your plans for the last long weekend of summer? #BankHoliday #Summer

angles.name: End of Summer
angles.copy: The Summer Bank Holiday on August 31st is often seen as the last hurrah before autumn. Make the most of it! #AugustBankHoliday

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Returns
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is set to return to BBC One with its launch show airing on Saturday, September 19th, featuring new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Glitterball Season
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing returns to BBC One on September 19th. New hosts, new celebs, same glitterball magic! #Strictly #StrictlyComeDancing

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: Exciting changes for Strictly this year! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking over hosting duties. Tune in from Sept 19th! #BBCStrictly

moments.title: The Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is confirmed to return to Channel 4 in September, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off Is Back
angles.copy: On your marks, get set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off returns to Channel 4 in September. Who's excited for another season of soggy bottoms and showstoppers? #GBBO #BakeOff

angles.name: New Judge
angles.copy: Big news for Bake Off fans! The iconic Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood as a judge this season, with Alison Hammond and Noel Fielding returning to host. Coming in September! #NigellaLawson
